reason: The text (Nehemiah 4) demonstrates clear coordination between leaders and people in rebuilding Jerusalem's wall. Nehemiah addresses the nobles (חֹרִים), deputies (סְגָנִים), and the rest of the people together, organizing them into family units with weapons. The phrase 'וַיְהִ֧י לֵ֦ב לָעָ֖ם לַעֲשֽׂוֹת' (and the people had a mind to work) shows unified purpose. The wall is rebuilt 'וַנָּ֤שָׁב כֻּלָּ֙נוּ֙ אֶל־ הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה' (we all returned to the wall) when threats emerged. The organizational structure shows officers (שָּׂרִ֔ים) positioned with the people, half working while half held weapons, and a coordinated communication system via trumpet for assembly. This demonstrates joint action toward a common goal with clear organizational structure uniting leaders and workers in effort.
